name: able-0.9.3-beta
body:
Able 0.9.3 beta.

- The updater now finds new versions reliably: it reads a small release file from the repository, which is not subject to GitHub's API request limit (shared by everyone on the same mobile network) and is never served stale. The GitHub API remains as a fallback.

If Able 0.9.1 or 0.9.2 says the request limit was reached or that there are no updates, install this APK once manually; from 0.9.3 on, updates work from Settings → Updates.
